content.hebrew: אֱלֹהֵי עוֹלָם, הָעוֹשֶׂה כֹל מֵאֶֽפֶס, וּבְאֵין מָקוֹם נִצַּֽבְתָּ,
content.transliteration: Elohē ‘olam, ha‘osē khol me’efes, uv’en maḳom nits’tsavta,
content.english: Eternal God, [You] who have made everything from nothing, and stand in no place,

content.hebrew: מִבֶּֽטֶן הִקְדַּֽשְׁתָּ יְרֵאֶֽיךָ, וְלַעֲבוֹדָתְךָ אֹתָם הִקְרַֽבְתָּ.
content.transliteration: Mibbeten hiḳdashta yere’ekha, vela’avodatekha otam hiḳravta.
content.english: You sanctified from the womb those who fear You, and brought them near to serve You.

content.hebrew: חֲנַנְתָּם בַּחֲסִידוּת, וּבְבָמֳתֵי אֶֽרֶץ הִרְכַּֽבְתָּ –
content.transliteration: Ḥanantam baḥasidut, uv’vamotē erets hirkavta.
content.english: You graciously gave them [opportunities for] piety, and let them ride over the high places of the earth—

content.hebrew: קהל: אֶת־בִּנְךָ אֶת־יְחִידְךָ אֲשֶׁר אָהָֽבְתָּ.  (בראשית כב:ב)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Et binekha et yeḥidekha asher ahavta.
content.english: Cong. Your son, Your only one, whom You love.    (Gen. 22:2)

content.hebrew: הֱבִינוֹתָם לְאַחַר בֹּאָם לָאָֽרֶץ וְאַחֲרֵי כָּבְשָׁם,
content.transliteration: Hevinotam le’aḥar bo’am la’arets ve’aḥarē kovsham,
content.english: You made them understand that after they have come to the Land and conquered it,

content.hebrew: לְהָבִיא מֵרֵאשִׁית כָּל־פְּרִי לְחַדְּשָׁם,
content.transliteration: Lehavi mereshit kol peri leḥaddesham,
content.english: They should offer the first of every fruit, to inaugurate them,

content.hebrew: וְיוֹבִֽילוּ אֶל הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר שָׁם יַכְנִֽיעוּ רֹאשָׁם,
content.transliteration: Veyovilu el hammaḳom asher sham yakhni‘u rosham,
content.english: And bring them to the place where they will bow their heads,

content.hebrew: קהל: אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַר יוי אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ לְשַׁכֵּן שְׁמוֹ שָׁם. (דברים כו:ב)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Asher yivḥar Adonai elohekha leshakken shemo sham.
content.english: Cong. Which Adonai your God will choose, to make His name dwell there. (Deut. 26:2)

content.hebrew: רַחֲמֵי אֵל יַבִּֽיעוּ, רַב הָעֲלִילִיָּה,
content.transliteration: Raḥamē El yabbi‘u, rav ha‘aliliyya,
content.english: They should express God’s acts of mercy, the One great in deeds.

content.hebrew: אַחֲרִיתָם שַׂגִּיא, וְרֵאשִׁיתָם מִצְעָר הָיָה,
content.transliteration: Aḥaritam saggi, vereshitam mits‘ar haya,
content.english: [The Israelite people] ended up great, [though] their beginning was miniscule.

content.hebrew: יוֹדוּ כִּי הֱבִיאָם אֶל אֶֽרֶץ לְתַלְפִּיּוֹת בְּנוּיָה,
content.transliteration: Yodu ki hevi’am el erets letalpiyyot benuya,
content.english: They should acknowledge that He has brought them to the Land built up mightily.

content.hebrew: קהל: וְגַם זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבַשׁ הִיא, וְזֶה פִּרְיָהּ.  (במדבר יג:כז)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Veḡam zavat ḥalav udvash hi, vezē piryah.
content.english: Cong. And moreover, it is flowing with milk and honey, and this is its fruit. (Num. 13:27)

content.hebrew: נֹֽעַם יוי יְסַפֵּֽרוּ, וּמַעֲשֵׂר לְהָבִיא בֵּית יוי בְּכָבוֹד מֻקָּף,
content.transliteration: No‘am Adonai yesapperu, uma‘aser lehavi bet Adonai bekhavod muḳḳaf,
content.english: They should tell of Adonai’s sweetness, and bring tithes to Adonai’s House, which is surrounded by [His] Glory.

content.hebrew: "בִּעַֽרְתִּי הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ מִבֵּיתִי." בָּרוּךְ כְּפוּפִים זָקַף.
content.transliteration: “Bi‘arti haḳḳodesh mibbeti.” Barukh kefufim zaḳaf.
content.english: [They should say]: “I have rid all the holy [produce] from my house.” Blessed is the One who straightens the stooped!

content.hebrew: בֵּרַךְ עַמּוֹ, וְרֹאשׁ צָרִים נִקַּף.
content.transliteration: Berakh ‘ammo, verosh tsarim niḳḳaf.
content.english: He has blessed His people, and the foe’s head is hewed down.

content.hebrew: קהל: אֱמֶת מֵאֶֽרֶץ תִּצְמַח וְצֶֽדֶק מִשָּׁמַֽיִם נִשְׁקָף. (תהלים פה:יב)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Emet me’erets titsmaḥ vetsedeḳ mish’shamayim nishḳaf.
content.english: Cong.Truth sprouts from the land, and justice looks down from heaven.  (Ps. 85:12)

content.hebrew: נִבָּא בֶן בּוּזִי כִּי הָרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל יְרַנֵּֽנוּ;
content.transliteration: Nibba ven Buzi ki harē Yisra’el yirannenu;
content.english: Buzi’s son prophesied that Israel’s mountains would sing joyously;

content.hebrew: פִּרְיָם יִשְׂאוּ לְעַם יוי, כִּי לָבוֹא פָּנוּ.
content.transliteration: Piryam yis’u le‘am Adonai, ki lavo panu
content.english: They will bring forth their fruit for Adonai’s people, for [the people] have turned their faces to come.

content.hebrew: יוּשָֽׁבוּ כְּקֶֽדֶם, וְאָדָם וּבְהֵמָה לָרֹב עֲלֵיהֶם יַחֲנוּ.
content.transliteration: Yushavu keḳedem, ve’adam uvhema larov ‘alehem yaḥanu.
content.english: May they be restored as in antiquity, and may people and livestock set camp there, numerously.

content.hebrew: קהל: וְאַתֶּם הָרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עַנְפְּכֶם תִּתֵּֽנוּ.  (יחזקאל לו:ח)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Ve’attem harē Yisra’el ‘annpekhem tittenu:
content.english: Cong. And you, Israel’s mountains, put forth your branches!   (Ezek. 36:8)

content.hebrew: חזן: [וְאַתֶּ֞ם הָרֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ עַנְפְּכֶ֣ם תִּתֵּ֔נוּ] וּפֶרְיְכֶ֥ם תִּשְׂא֖וּ לְעַמִּ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ֥י קֵרְב֖וּ לָבֽוֹא: (יחזקאל לו:ח)
content.transliteration: Ḥazzan: Ve’attem harē Yisra’el ‘annpekhem tittenu ufiryekhem tis’u le‘ammi Yisra’el ḳi ḳerevu lavo:
content.english: Cantor. And you, Israel’s mountains, put forth your branches, and give forth your fruit for My people Israel; for they will soon be coming near. (Ezek. 36:8)

content.hebrew: כִּי֩ יְרַחֵ֨ם יו֜י אֶֽת־יַֽעֲקֹ֗ב וּבָחַ֥ר עוֹד֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְהִנִּיחָ֖ם עַל־אַדְמָתָ֑ם וְנִלְוָ֤ה הַגֵּר֙ עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם וְנִסְפְּח֖וּ עַל־בֵּ֥ית יַֽעֲקֹֽב: (ישעיהו יד:א)
content.transliteration: Ki yeraḥem Adonai et Ya‘aḳov uvaḥar od beYisra’el vehinniḥam ‘al admatam venilva hagger ‘alehem venispeḥu ‘al bet Ya‘aḳov:
content.english: For Adonai will have mercy over Jacob, and again choose Israel, and place them on their ground; and sojourners will be joined to them, and will be added to the House of Jacob. (Isa. 14:1)

content.hebrew: שְׁמַ֤ע אֵלַי֙ יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב וְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מְקֹֽרָאִ֑י אֲנִי־הוּא֙ אֲנִ֣י רִאשׁ֔וֹן אַ֖ף אֲנִ֥י אַֽחֲרֽוֹן: (ישעיהו מח:יב)
content.transliteration: Shema‘ elai Ya‘aḳov veYisra’el meḳora’i ani hu ani rishon af ani aḥaron:
content.english: Hear me, Jacob, and Israel, who are called by Me: I am He, I am the first, and I am also the last. (Isa. 48:12)

content.hebrew: קהל: שְׁמַ֖ע יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל יו֥י אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ יו֥י ׀ אֶחָֽד: (דברים ו:ד)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Shema‘ Yisra’el Adonai elohenu Adonai, eḥad:
content.english: Cong. Hear O Israel, Adonai our God is Adonai on His own. (Deut. 6:4)
content.comments: Adonai on His own. The translation follows Sefer Ha-mivḥar, on Deuteronomy 6:4: “The meaning is that He is one and does not need any second one.”
